import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-5ebffd84.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            y0=min(y for y,x in comp); y1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            x0=min(x for y,x in comp); x1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            if y1-y0>=2 and x1-x0>=2:
                for y in range(y0+1,y1):
                    for x in range(x0+1,x1):
                        if grid[y][x]==bg: out[y][x]=2
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(source)

for c in range(13,20): grid[6][c]=grid[12][c]=4
for r in range(6,13): grid[r][13]=grid[r][19]=4
for r,vals in [(14,[5,5,5]),(15,[5,1,5]),(16,[5,5,5])]:
 for j,v in enumerate(vals):grid[r][10+j]=v
ans=mod.transform(grid)
print(ans)
